The petitioner submits that, upon the petitioner discussing about the wedding plans and respondent demanded for a grand church wedding and along with a good sum of Amount and a Car, and insisted that upon the demand being fulfilled he intended to marry the petitioner in the month of July 2017. The respondent on June 11th 2017 in Drunken state came to the petitioners house and spoke rubbish and demanded 30 Lakhs along with the marriage expenses as dowry. The petitioner submits that for the first time the respondent sent a picture of a lady and stated that he was in relationship with the said lady called Diana, the petitioner coming to the know the same the conversation with him and called off the marriage discussions. The petitioner submits that he would never allow the petitioner to wear the clothes she want, he would dictate the clothes she wore and the food she ate, he always had a racist comments against Malayees and Tamilians calling them (Chute's and Psychos) as the petitioner had early graying problem, he would did not want her to colour and always taunted to her look old. The Petitioner submits that Respondent made a thorough check of petitioner's belongings when she was about to leave for her parent's house and when the Petitioner returned back he taunted her with regard to her belongings and humiliated her for not bringing enough Jewellery's and Silk Sarees as demanded and commented harshly on the clothes that was there in the luggage. The petitioner submits, upon sensing with regard to the respondent job upon enquiring him he stated that he was not working and he married the petitioner just to pay the House EMI as she was getting a good salary. The petitioner found lot of ladies undergarments (Old and New) and upon questioning the respondent informed that it was his dead wife's and insisted the petitioner to wear them and upon refusing the same the respondent assaulted the petitioner and put her out of the house for entire day. The petitioner submits that the respondent would pickup fight with the petitioner for every small issue and state that she was an incomplete women in every aspect be it driving, cooking and make fun of her with his nephew and used to post bad about her in the social media as he is very active on social media but did not change the status in the social media, but maintained that he was single upon questioning the with regard to post the status as married he stated his mother would not allow him to post wedding pictures, later confessed that Diana would feel bad. The petitioner submits that sensing respondent continuing the relationship with Diana, the petitioner found that Smt. The petitioner found that the phone photo gallery was filled with his and Diana's photos, when confronted he very calmly replied that he kept the photos because they were nice and memories of his relationship with Diana. The petitioner submits that on 8th Sep on St. Mary's feast day he was drunk again and he had changed his whatsapp DP to wedding picture upon seeing the whatsapp DP that day whole night Diana was calling on his phone and the next day the petitioner saw a message from Diana asking the respondent to pick her up at the airport at 1.30 am. He mentioned in a message to the petitioner that Diana was coming home and later called the petitioner and instructed to go to her mother house, upon hearing the said fact the petitioner was shocked, and further instructed that if she continued to stay there a scene would be created and the petitioner refusing she would set out of the house and stated that not to return till Diana had left the house, stating that it was his house and could bring anyone and the next day the respondent happened to take Diana for a walk in front of the whole locality, which he had never done with the petitioner. The petitioner submits that until 8th Sept the respondent had been sending love messages to Diana, and assuring her he would marry her and he had informed her that he was marrying the petitioner only for the EMI and will divorce her after the house loan amount was cleared. It was also revealed that the respondent had told Diana the petitioner was living with her mother and their marriage had not consummated inspite of having a long honeymoon. The petitioner submits that Diana happened to call the petitioner and reveal all the fact enquiring whether the said fact was true, the respondent had revealed about his bedroom experience with the petitioner and had also stated about his fanaticize with virgin. The petitioner submits that the said Diana called up the petitioner and instructed the petitioner to divorce the respondent as she intended to marry him as she was in process of obtaining divorce form her husband. The petitioner submits that as the petitioner visited the matrimonial house inspite of the order from the respondent it was found that they both were in compromising position, hugging and pampering each other, despite protesting the same they continued and Diana left after 2 days. The next day Diana called the petitioner and abused her and later when the same was resisted she pacified explained her past and then demanded the petitioner to agree to share the respondent with her, for which the petitioner had to blankly refuse, upon coming to the conversation between the petitioner and Diana the respondent physically assaulted the petitioner. The petitioner submits that the petitioner tried getting him a job through her contacts but if he was unsuccessful he would abused the petitioner for not assisting him, on 27th Sep 2017 the petitioner got to know she had conceived upon coming to know the same the respondent behavior towards her changed, and directed to abort the pregnancy and upon refusing, the respondent started complaining about the expenses of the medicine the doctor had prescribed and again physically assaulted her as such the petitioner had to go under depression. The petitioner submits that on 3rd Oct 2017 the petitioner upon checking the cell phone of the respondent there was a conversation about his sexual escapades with Diana during 2016 Christmas. The petitioner had a suffocating atmosphere everyday with him and saw his frequent call list where Diana was on that, upon enquiring about the same the conversation he got violent hurling abuses at petitioner and her mother calling them prostitutes. The petitioner submits that, on the next day the petitioner had visited her mother house as she was not keeping well, the respondent visited their house and he used filthy abusive language and said if the petitioner wanted to live with him, the petitioner had to give him 50 Lakhs. In the heated arguments the respondent assaulted and pushed the petitioner and tried to throttle her neck, fearing for worse the petitioner had to call her mother in the mid-night and later was rescued by her neighbors, after returning home the next day the respondent called upon the petitioner and asked her to return the Mangalasutra and diamond ring and leave the house. The petitioner submits that, due to the assault by the respondent the petitioner sustained injuries, stress and trauma of going through such horrifying experiences and had to hospitalize in Jain Hospital, and later in Rajmahal Vilas Hospital and Bangalore Medical & Surgical Centre hospital and it was diagnosed as miscarriage due to injuries and bleeding as such the petitioner had to undergo incomplete abortion procedure, even in such an event the respondent did not turn up to look after the petitioner. The respondent had gone with Diana for a holiday. The petitioner submits that she is yet to come out of the shock and the procedures. The Petitioner submits that, in spite of the mental torcher and harassment of the respondents, she was able to stay with Respondents thinking that Respondent may change over a period of time and things may get right. texts.respondent_arguments: The Petitioner submits that, the Respondent is involved in socializing and flirting with random girls fulfilling his unnatural sexual desire and fantasies and on several occasions Respondent have body shamed petitioner and neglected the petitioner in all the ways. The Petitioner submits that, on 8th October 2017 unable to bear Respondent torture and lack of support of affection and love from the Respondent, the petitioner was forced to leave the house and reside in her parent's house. The Petitioner submits that, Respondent has totally neglected to maintain the petitioner and violated the dignity, and further the systematic verbal and emotional abuse is continued every day and she is unable to bear the said torture, and Respondents have subject her to domestic violence and cruelty which is physical, sexual, verbal, economical, mental and she fears safety to her life. The Petitioner submits that, the petitioner has serious apprehensions that the respondent and Diana would harm the petitioner at her residence and her workplace as the respondent is addicted to consuming alcohol and has serious violent behaviour. The Petitioner submits that, the respondent is addicted to alcohol and petitioner has reasons to believe that the respondent suffers from serious mental and psychological disorders making the safety and welfare of the petitioner and her mother. The petitioner submits that, respondent is also liable to provide alternate residence to the aggrieved person in the same standard enjoyed by the respondent and commensurate with his family status. The Petitioner submits that the petitioner and her family incurred expenditure engagement, marriage and delivery and dowry. The respondent is liable to pay and reimburse as sum of Rs.10,00,000 to the petitioner. The Petitioner has been harassed and tortured physically and mentally by the respondent and continued to be harass even as on date. The petitioner has been subjected to domestic violence and cruelty which was physical, verbal, economic and mental by the respondent. The Petitioner has been a victim of domestic violence in the hands of Smt. Jyothi Loveena vs Sri Anthony D'Silva on 20 March, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191199456/ 7 the respondent. The respondent has subjected the petitioner to physical abuse, verbal, sexual, emotional abuse and economic abuse. The complainant submits that, the jurisdictional police may be directed to assist the petitioner to file a complaint, for physical and emotional abuse. The complainant is also seeking for relief under section 18, 19, 20 and 22 read with Section 23 of the Domestic violence Act. The complainant is also seeking an order respect to monetary relief under section 20(3) of the Domestic Violence Act 2008. It is prayed that the Hon'ble Court may take cognizance of the complaint and pass all of the orders deemed necessary in the circumstances of the case.
texts.other_lawyer_arguments: (a) Pass protection orders under section 18 and (b) Pass residence orders under section 19 and (c) Direct the respondent to pay monetary relief under section 20 (d) Direct the respondents to grant compensation or damages under section 22 and (e) Pass such interim orders as the Court deems just & proper (f) Pass any orders as deems fit in the circumstances of the case Orders required: (i) Protection order under section 18 Prohibiting aiding or abetting in the commission of acts of domestic violence Prohibiting the respondent from entering the residence of the aggrieved person where she is residing as stated in the cause title and the office of the aggrieved person at IBM India Private Limited, Embassy Manyatha Tech Park, Bangalore where she is working or any place frequented by the aggrieved person. Prohibiting the respondent from communicating with the petitioner or any family of the petitioner either by phone, print or electronic media including social websites. Prohibiting the respondent from causing violence to the dependants, other relatives or any person of the aggrieved person. (ii) Residence Order under section 19: An order directing the respondent: To provide an alternate suitable accommodation to the aggrieved person in the same standard as that of the matrimonial home and pay the rents for the same or in the alternative pay the rents for suitable accommodation. To return all the Jewelleries, house hold items, clothes and other house hold items in the name of the petitioner. (iii) Monetary reliefs under section 20: Medical expenses of Rs.3,00,000/- Directing the respondents to pay the following expenses as monetary relief as monetary relief: Food, clothes, medications, household expenses and other basic necessities amount of Rs.25,000/- per month.
